name: Which paint finish works best on kitchen walls?

mainEntity.name: Which paint finish works best on kitchen walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Satin or semi-gloss paints are the most common finishes for kitchen walls because they resist moisture, grease, and frequent scrubbing. Flat or matte finishes absorb stains and can show burnishing when wiped down, making them poorly suited for high-splatter zones near stoves and sinks. If your kitchen walls have surface imperfections or older drywall, satin offers a balanced middle ground by hiding minor flaws while still allowing you to clean off cooking residue easily. Semi-gloss is typically preferred on trim, baseboards, and window casings where extra moisture defense is required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin or semi-gloss finishes work best for kitchen walls because they resist grease, handle moisture well, and stand up to routine scrubbing without staining.
